v_1_3_1.title: Version 1.3.1 (Hotfix)
changes: Fixed issue where the tag modal opened with the color selector expanded.
Fixed sorting error inside folders.
Fixed errors when changing song metadata.
Added option to hide the sync library toast when the app comes to the foreground.
Fixed issue where the app started with a white flash screen.
Changed PlayerScreen UI for better comfort and accessibility.

v_1_3_0.title: Version 1.3.0 (Stable)
changes: Persistent playback position: the app remembers where you left off in each song and resumes from that point.
Multiple artists sheet: new bottom sheet that lists all collaborating artists for a track.
Album Artist support: reads the 'Album Artist' tag for more accurate album grouping.
last_modified column in database: the scanner detects file metadata changes and updates the library automatically.
Sleep Timer: automatically pauses playback after 5, 10, 20, 30, 45 minutes or 1 hour.
Share audio: share any track's audio file directly from the player or the track context menu.
Track menu max height with scroll: the context menu now has a maximum height and scrolls instead of filling the screen.
Fixed navigation issue when entering an artist from a folder view.
New 'Previous' button behavior: returns to the start of the current song instead of skipping back if time has elapsed.
Fixed and improved the playback history system.

v_1_2_0.title: Version 1.2.0 (Stable)
changes: Implemented internationalization support (multi-language).
Added an error toast message when trying to create a tag that already exists.
Fixed Android back button navigation behavior when viewing a folder's content.
Added informative text messages when the library is empty.
Added the ability to add entire folders to a playlist.
Fixed the sorting functionality within the Library.
Implemented excluding of individual songs from library scanning.
Added a visual indicator to show when a song is already added to a playlist.

v_1_1_0.title: Version 1.1.0 (Stable)
changes: Rendering Optimization (No Flickering): Avoids visual flickering in covers and detail header images when the player status changes.
Persistent Nullcover Injection: Directly injects a default cover in the database for tracks without artwork, speeding up navigation.
Improved Collaborating Artists Support: Scanner strictly splits collaborators using a comma (",") instead of a forward slash.
Memory Leak Prevention: Avoids state updates on unmounted components when navigating quickly and asynchronously.
Robust against Corrupt Songs: Safely loads playlists by ignoring corrupt tracks in the database without freezing the app.
FAB Playback Safety: Prevents playing albums or artists with empty queues, avoiding native crashes.
Device Cache Cleaning: Automatically deletes temporary covers cached when choosing files.
UI and Callback Optimization: Removed inline anonymous functions and memorized components in main screen for ultra-smooth scrolling.

v_1_1_0_beta.title: Version 1.1.0-beta
changes: Smart File Synchronization: Scanner is now passive, running only at 4 key events (app startup, returning from background, changes in excluded folders, or manual refresh). Eliminates unnecessary CPU and battery drain in background.

Chunk Queue Loading: Redesigned the loading engine to support massive libraries (1,000, 2,000, or 5,000+ tracks). Pressing "Play all" or "Shuffle" plays audio instantly in under 100ms while indexing the rest in the background without freezing the app.
Cascading Global Delete: Deleting a file from storage or excluding a folder purges its database trace from playlists, history, and searches, cleanly stopping playback if the file was playing.
Collaborators Fix: Fixed scanner ignoring secondary artists. Now strictly splits collaborations using connectors like ~, &, ,, y, feat., or ft.
Repair Metadata (Soft Repair): Added a button in configuration to rescan and restore missing collaborators from previous versions without affecting playlists, favorites, or playback history.
Factory Rescan (Hard Reset): Added a button in configuration to fully wipe the local database and rescan from scratch.
Pixel-Perfect Marquee Text: Adjusted pixel tolerance on long titles so the smooth scroll animation starts precisely, avoiding ellipsis truncation on Android.
Native Navigation Fix: Fixed tab bar behavior; pressing the active tab prevents ghost reloads and screen flicker.
Smart Keyboard Manager: Keyboard dismisses automatically when long-pressing an item or opening any context menus on the search tab.
Confirmation Toasts: Added global floating toasts to visually confirm queueing an item, adding to playlist, or adding to favorites.
Complete Queue Control: Added a button in player menu to manually clear the queue or stop audio playback entirely.
Comprehensive Artist Ecosystem: Play all tracks of an artist instantly or queue them in block. Home tab now saves and displays Recent Artists alongside albums and songs.

v_1_0_0_beta.title: Official Beta
changes: First official beta version of MMPlayer.
Ultra-fast playback using a local database (WatermelonDB).
Premium dark interface running at 120Hz thanks to FlashList v2.
Multiple performance fixes.
